decisions.reason: As a low-cost complementary accessory, it is cheap to keep available and still preserves option value even if demand is only moderate.
A homepage-featured box car trailer series sits close to the firm's core business, so its market value was likely validated enough to continue.
The car transporter trailer serves a narrower niche and is costlier to support, but it remains close enough to the firm's capabilities to keep as an option for now.
A low-bed trailer series is strategically adjacent to the core trailer range and is likely worth retaining given modular production and still-uncertain future demand.
A high trailer cover series can build on existing trailer platforms, so the cost of keeping it on offer is relatively low compared with its potential upside.
As another box car trailer series, it faces some portfolio-overlap risk, but repeated homepage promotion suggests it still merits being kept for now.
